row.proto: void Sess_Invalidate_Lap_Thunk(void *rules, uint32_t vehicle, uint32_t reason, char mode)
row.notes: jmp stub into .data1 (0x1505beb00). Invalidate a lap of car param_2 for reason param_3 (byte; 0x22 skips the record in mode 1), mode param_4: 1 = current lap, 2 = next lap, 3 = previous lap; 0 = nothing. Uses the car's lap-history ring ([[rules+0x1c48]+0x58][car], index byte +0x9c80, 200 entries of 200 bytes, valid bit at +0xe0 vs +0xd8) and returns without effect when the target lap is already invalid. Records it via 0x1435668e0 (types 10/11/14) and 0x143573400 (types 12/13/15) and posts the penalty bus message (vtable 0x14584ec18, car, reason, kind 1/2/3) to [0x14618b3b8]+8. Callers 0x14356bcc0, 0x14356bf29, 0x14356c953, 0x14356d886 (track-limit / corner-cut checks). (used by vmknolle track-limits)

verify.notes: V1045 5-byte jmp to .data1 0x1505beb00; mode 1/2/3 checks the per-lap valid flag (lap ring at +0x9c80, 200B records) and issues penalty types 10/12, 11/13, 14/15 (this / this+next / this+previous lap invalidated, with/without reason) via 0x1435668e0 + 0x143573400 and posts event 0x14584ec18; 4 args match proto
